overview:
**Moderate fire danger holds across the Montrose High Elevation zone today, with ERC at 63% and light-to-moderate winds the main story.**
- Week-ahead trend: Moderate danger persists through Oct 16, with ERC/BI readings hovering in the low-to-mid 60s all week.
- Weather driver: a weekend storm system brings scattered showers and thunderstorms today and tonight, with highs near 55-64°F and winds out of the ENE/NNE at 9-14 mph.
- Watchout status: 0 of 7 local thresholds met; no Red Flag Warning or fire weather watch is in effect for this area.
- Restrictions: no fire restrictions are currently active — Montrose County lifted its Stage 1 ban in September, and nearby BLM field offices have also rescinded their restrictions.
- Nearby incidents: the national situation report shows no new or uncontained large fires in this area's counties today.
- Fuel moisture: 1000-hr fuels remain steady at 16-17%, reflecting the recent precipitation trend.
